task.title: Enabling the dual-stack protocol family
task.shortdesc: To enable dual-stack (IPv4 and IPv6) support on your standalone Red Hat Quay deployment, you can set FEATURE_LISTEN_IP_VERSION to dual-stack in your config.yaml file and restart the registry.

ul.li: Your host and container software platform (Docker, Podman) must be configured to support IPv6.

step.cmd: In your deployment’s config.yaml file, add the FEATURE_LISTEN_IP_VERSION parameter and set it to dual-stack, for example:

info.codeblock: FEATURE_GOOGLE_LOGIN: false FEATURE_INVITE_ONLY_USER_CREATION: false FEATURE_LISTEN_IP_VERSION: dual-stack FEATURE_MAILING: false FEATURE_NONSUPERUSER_TEAM_SYNCING_SETUP: false
